evidence: A longtime user calls Aqua Mail solid and highly customizable, recommends it for heavy phone-email use, and flags its changed payment model.

evidence_sources.author: jdoss
evidence_sources.excerpt: It's been solid and it is super customizable. I think the only downside is they changed their payment model a while back and if you didn't buy it back then it costs monthly fee or a $99.99 for a lifetime license. I highly recomend it if you do a lot of email on your phone.
